label: krk-tuned-s0
resisted: Nothing structural. In domain terms the network only partly implements the draw rule: it detects 'rook on a square next to the black king' (AUC 0.997 against Chebyshev distance 1) but does not model the white king defending the rook (wk_file unconnected, wk_rank weight -0.035; capture-vs-defended AUC 0.548 among the 2,360 adjacent positions) or stalemate (8 rows, mean p 0.15). The soft additive AND leaves adjacent positions at mean p 0.53 and under-scores the column one file to the right of the black king (609 of 810 false negatives). The only defence-related signal is a weak level effect in the rank tent (corr 0.39 with bk_rank; capture-vs-defended AUC 0.57), so that part is partial, not a defence detector.
tool_bugs: None blocking. Root annotation: child exits must be entry_nodes but not listed in subgraph_nodes (first two attempts rejected, as already recorded for adult-s0). Complex shell compounds were refused by the worktree sandbox, so calls went through small scratch wrappers (call.py / batch.py) that invoke experiments/complex_real/xn.py with DATABASE_URL set. category_offsets returns no groups (expected: ordinal inputs, no one-hot categories).
summary: P(draw) = sigmoid(-1.80 + F(wr_file - bk_file) + G(wr_rank, bk_rank) - 0.035 z(wk_rank)). F is a tent in the rook-minus-black-king file offset that is ~0 only for offsets -1 and 0 (penalised -1 at +1, -3.7 to -6 further away); G is a tent in the rank offset peaking for offsets -1..+1. Added in logit, they make a soft AND that says 'the rook stands next to the black king', i.e. the geometric half of the capture rule. White-king defence and stalemate are not modelled, so the network is slightly worse than a plain adjacency indicator (train AUC 0.9932 vs 0.9955).

leaf_assessments.name: file_offset_tent
leaf_assessments.hypothesis_short: Tent in dF = wr_file - bk_file: ~0 logit when the rook is on the black king's file or one file left, -0.98 one file right, -3.7..-6 further away (file half of 'rook adjacent').
leaf_assessments.why: Exit depends only on dF (spread <= 0.11 within a dF value) and separates |dF|<=1 from |dF|>1 with AUC 1.0 on all 22,444 training rows; draw rate 0.298 inside vs 0.0004 outside. Exception stated: the dF=+1 column is under-scored by ~0.9 logit despite the same draw rate as dF=-1, causing 609 of 810 false negatives.

leaf_assessments.name: rank_offset_tent
leaf_assessments.hypothesis_short: Tent in dR = wr_rank - bk_rank peaking (+2.1..+2.9) for |dR|<=1 (rank half of 'rook adjacent'); small boost when both pieces are high on the board.
leaf_assessments.why: Separates |dR|<=1 from |dR|>1 with AUC 1.0 on train. The level effect matches the domain fact that the white king (ranks 1-4) cannot defend a high rook, but only weakly (capture-vs-defended AUC 0.57 among adjacent positions), so that secondary reading is partial.

leaf_assessments.name: wk_rank_negligible
leaf_assessments.hypothesis_short: Negligible linear term -0.038 logit per white-king rank; the network does not model white-king defence.
leaf_assessments.why: Ablating it changes AUC by 7e-5 and p by <= 0.02. Its sign weakly agrees with 'a low white king defends less' (AUC 0.60 among adjacent positions) but the effect size is too small for any domain role; the substantive (true) statement is the null one.

composition_notes: Root rook_adjacent_box (ann_12): sigmoid(-1.80 + idn_file + idn_rank + idn_wk), additive in logit; entries are the three child exits plus the unconnected wk_file (-1). The additive combination of two tents is a soft AND: logit > 0 for 64% of adjacent positions and 0% of non-adjacent ones; the in-box logits range -0.72 (dF=+1, dR=+1) to +1.02 (dF=-1, dR=0). Three identity nodes (idn_file, idn_rank, idn_wk) intercept the edges into the output so each leaf has one exit; no splits were needed.

ground_truth_comparisons.rows: training split, 22,444 rows (2,237 draws: 2,229 captures + 8 stalemates)

restore_gain.reading: Both tents carry the nonlinear signal and each is needed; together they lift AUC from ~0.56 (about logistic regression) to 0.993.

unit_activity_summary: All 6 hidden ReLUs are hinges (none dead, rare or always on): 2949 active 71%, 358 50%, 1729 61%, 7005 50%, 463 87% (off only for bk_rank 1), 18 45%. Logit SD of direct output contributions: 18 4.25, 463 2.30, 358 2.05, 7005 1.53.
